scope: SOURCE PRESERVED: exactly35baseline transition source contracts plus4machines whose complete frozen edge sets are covered. No execution qualification.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: scanContracts skips an optional inactive codec, validates supported representation/path and strict directory entries, rejects duplicate IDs/kind mismatch and HTML+Markdown slug ambiguity.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Catalog construction returns only the inspected entries; spec/plan scan errors propagate. Selected work dispatch precedes catalog scan.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Malformed strict artifacts may veto catalog-based operations; selected direct reads/progress avoid that scan, while explicit attachment still validates a catalog binding.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Commit/derived-write source intent and error propagation are inspected; OS locking, fsync/rename failure timing and complete-store recovery execution are outside this proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Approved requires approved governance, matching artifact/normative/hash and a Load-validated approval subject.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Status reports authority_verified and reason separately from stored governance; inspection does not rewrite progress.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Unavailable/stale approval candidates are skipped and absence yields AUTHORITY_UNVERIFIED; this is not automatic progress rollback.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Producer-specific collector/host correctness and installed permissions remain separately qualified. Current generic schema/hash/link dispatch is inspected; accepted profile extensions are not a claim those producers executed.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Activity-specific subject/kind/readiness guards bind prompt digest, task/checkpoint or exact draft pair; review completion selection must match original inputs.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Content-addressed evidence-context bytes are created through PutDerived; pair projection is cloned and not committed as approval.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Wrong subject, stale completion context, failed guard or invalid context schema returns an error before a usable context reference.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Producer-specific collector/host correctness and installed permissions remain separately qualified. Current generic schema/hash/link dispatch is inspected; accepted profile extensions are not a claim those producers executed.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Capture loads the policy source, requires current observed format and exact active subject/context, rejects paired/SMARTS bypass routes, and dispatches profile-specific link validation.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: storeReceipt creates or compares event then receipt at content hashes; result explicitly says artifact_approval_changed=false.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Identical retained event bytes permit missing receipt completion; mismatches/I/O errors refuse, and legacy raw capture cannot mint authority.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Producer-specific collector/host correctness and installed permissions remain separately qualified. Current generic schema/hash/link dispatch is inspected; accepted profile extensions are not a claim those producers executed.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Inspect hash-checks receipt/event, current observation/context links and source equality; legacy receipt schema is selected only for inventory.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Returns a retained chain object without relabeling historical v0.1 receipts as current.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Missing or changed retained objects and schema/link disagreement reject; caller-supplied readers cannot install a trusted whole-chain cache.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Producer-specific collector/host correctness and installed permissions remain separately qualified. Current generic schema/hash/link dispatch is inspected; accepted profile extensions are not a claim those producers executed.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Load builds on Inspect and rejects legacy receipt/event/observation formats; SMARTS additionally needs its intact paired user grant and exact protected scope.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Current authority derives from verified chain and Subject identities rather than actor/source prose alone.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Stale subject or missing/corrupt grant stays rejected; cooperative attestation is not host permission or independent human authentication.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Producer-specific collector/host correctness and installed permissions remain separately qualified. Current generic schema/hash/link dispatch is inspected; accepted profile extensions are not a claim those producers executed.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Page enforces4096..65536 budget and exact selection/purpose/artifact/symbol/budget on continuation; items are whole records.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Returns complete records plus an immutable page token or completed context ticket, so contextual reads write infrastructure.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: No fitting record yields RECORD_TOO_LARGE; malformed cursor/offset or token failure returns an error, without partial-record slicing.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Producer-specific collector/host correctness and installed permissions remain separately qualified. Current generic schema/hash/link dispatch is inspected; accepted profile extensions are not a claim those producers executed.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Context recomputes document/authority vector and record manifest before Page compares continuation hashes.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: A changed contributing vector or manifest produces STALE_CURSOR rather than continuation under an old identity.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Caller must restart a coherent read; emitted tickets represent delivery only and grant no comprehension, permission or approval.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Producer-specific collector/host correctness and installed permissions remain separately qualified. Current generic schema/hash/link dispatch is inspected; accepted profile extensions are not a claim those producers executed.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: source-observed basis requires nonempty source_refs, and Structural resolves each source reference to an active sources record.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: record.update changes the selected record fields then render.Prepare revalidates structure; provenance remains caller classification.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Absent/retired source references or invalid shapes fail validation, without promoting a claim into authenticated truth.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Commit/derived-write source intent and error propagation are inspected; OS locking, fsync/rename failure timing and complete-store recovery execution are outside this proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Command details belong only to command records; cwd and closed argv/purpose/run_state schema remain required.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: run_state permits unrun/reported-pass/reported-fail as stored knowledge fields; this update/render path executes no stored command or receipt producer.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Invalid command shapes reject; reported knowledge state remains separate from task checks and strict verification.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Commit/derived-write source intent and error propagation are inspected; OS locking, fsync/rename failure timing and complete-store recovery execution are outside this proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Both typed spec+plan and same slug are required; canonical bounded UTF8 sources need active mapping targets, complete disjoint line coverage and unused provenance IDs.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Preview returns source/target/normative/model hashes and semantic_mapping_verified=false with all targets drafts.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Missing/overlapping/out-of-range mappings, reserved IDs, bad pair binding or source reads reject; mapping meaning and old approval are not automatically endorsed.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Commit/derived-write source intent and error propagation are inspected; OS locking, fsync/rename failure timing and complete-store recovery execution are outside this proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Apply reconstructs preview and requires identical preview_sha256 plus the closed review request before preparing edits.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: One Commit writes both draft HTML targets and removes exact Markdown before-images, retaining mapping note and original bytes.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Changed source/mapping rejects STALE_PREVIEW; uncertain prepared transactions require recovery, and old approvals are not transferred.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Commit/derived-write source intent and error propagation are inspected; OS locking, fsync/rename failure timing and complete-store recovery execution are outside this proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Rollback requires a committed cutover journal with paired canonical Markdown removal/HTML creation shapes, exact current after hashes and verified backups.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: A new Commit restores original Markdown and deletes introduced HTML, preserving original cutover journal history.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Any intervening candidate bytes or corrupt backup refuses recovery; pending/uncertain cutover cannot be relabeled a completed rollback.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Commit/derived-write source intent and error propagation are inspected; OS locking, fsync/rename failure timing and complete-store recovery execution are outside this proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Selected native work identity/project and exact revision/model CAS precede a queued-only start.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Sets active and UTC start date; start mapping runs on the clone before the same local commit.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: A nonqueued source state or stale identity rejects; this path does not send a provider mutation.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Complete accepts only queued or active selected work under exact CAS.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Sets complete/date and stages configured mapped desire atomically; it does not assign check_status or plan acceptance.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Other source states reject; recorded completion is not test, PR merge or release delivery evidence.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Only completed work may reopen, with native owner and exact CAS.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Sets active, clears completed_at and fills missing started_at; mapped reopen uses the same clone transaction.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: All other lifecycle states refuse; no external send is performed by reopening.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Archive rejects already archived work and retains selected-work CAS.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Only local execution state becomes archived; mapping is called only for start/complete/reopen.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Start, complete and reopen exclude archived state; no unarchive transition or mapped archive send is created.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Rename requires title; attach validates selected spec/plan correspondence; set-cycle requires explicit value/null and render validates final fields.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Descriptive/cycle references change while execution lifecycle/check fields remain untouched.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Missing attachments, broken catalog binding, invalid fields or stale selected-work CAS refuse.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Observe-delivery validates repository pattern, positive PR number, closed state enum and exact UTC timestamp; URL is derived from repository/number.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Stores delivery_observation independently without changing work state or check_status.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Malformed identity/time/state rejects, and even observed merged state cannot auto-complete work or pass checks.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Current provider/project generation, verified synchronized issue and empty existing Project effect are required.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Stages local pending add_item with exact issue and binding generation; no network client is called.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Existing Project effect or unsynchronized/unbound issue refuses, preserving the prior intent/binding.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Requires same verified item/issue/generation, valid field/desired option, eligible synchronized/conflict or unclaimed mapped pending state, and explicit expected option/null.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Stages set_single_select with frozen expected baseline; manual staging removes mapping ownership, records superseded intent and clears observed option.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Unknown attempted effect or invalid item/config/field fails before a new local commit.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Pending/current generation and attempt ID are required; mapped claims check exact transition/intent and configured timing/merge fields.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Claim sets outcome_unknown and attempt identity durably, with mapped coordination waiting_reconciliation.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Duplicate unknown claim returns EFFECT_UNKNOWN; manual claims bypass mapped timing policy rather than adopting it implicitly.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Record must match pre-send outcome_unknown attempt, current issue/generation and valid item; set-field readback must equal selected item and desired option.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Stores synchronized item/field observation and updates only matching mapped coordination.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Wrong attempt, item or observed option rejects; requesting a mutation alone never constitutes readback success.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Conflict is limited to pending/unknown set-field, with the exact attempt if sent and a value different from both expected and desired.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Stores conflict/observed option and moves matching mapped coordination to waiting_manual.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Equal expected/desired values or invalid send identity refuse; this handler launches no compensating overwrite.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: An enabled finite transition map freezes its own generation and issue/project generations for start/complete/reopen.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Deterministic transition ID includes project/work/operation/prior revision; desired targets, superseded ID and eligible effects are committed together.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Invalid optional map records unavailable states; unexpected read/I/O error aborts the local transition before Commit.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Disabled mapping preserves saved desires and causes mapped claim checks to return EFFECT_PAUSED.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: New local coordination records paused target states and superseded transition while existing effect records remain in place.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Pausing does not clear or cancel a previously claimed unknown effect and causes no automatic send.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Retirement requires unchanged mapping generation, exact prior transition+intent, pending state and nil attempt.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Only that unsent mapped intent returns to synchronized observed baseline, removing desired/mapping ownership fields.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Unknown, manual, foreign-transition or foreign-generation effects fail the guard and remain available for reconciliation.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: stageMappedIssue rereads provider config and compares its generation to the frozen desire.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Unavailable/changed optional provider produces binding_changed, retaining desired outcome without remote retargeting.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Unexpected provider I/O errors propagate; no request is sent to a newly selected provider.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Missing verified issue binding yields waiting_binding and retains predecessor create intent when present.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Current unknown becomes waiting_reconciliation; manual pending/conflict becomes waiting_manual; stale mapped generation becomes binding_changed.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Each wait returns without replacing the uncertain/manual effect or inventing a bound issue.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: A current synchronized bound issue with a known open/closed recorded state remains eligible even if desire equals the saved state.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Stages a new pending status_update with deterministic mapped intent and clears prior merge fields.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Saved equality is not treated as current provider success; adapter readback is still required after claim.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: stageMappedProject validates current Project generation and same bound issue/item before staging.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Missing item/binding yields waiting_binding; config drift yields binding_changed, unknown waiting_reconciliation, manual/conflict waiting_manual.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Returns without changing provider target or overwriting held effects; no network mutation occurs.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: A synchronized add_item or mismatched/unknown field baseline cannot supply a known option.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Records awaiting_observation rather than manufacturing null as expected_remote_option_id.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Resume must supply the explicit first current item/option observation; unobserved baseline cannot stage.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Known observed option is used, or an existing pending set-field retains its original explicit expected baseline.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Stages mapped set_single_select pending with expected option, deterministic intent and exact frozen field/desired value.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Absent baseline returns awaiting_observation; subsequent external races remain adapter readback/conflict work.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Resume requires exact selected-work CAS and current enabled saved map generation; supplied option is allowed only with the exact first bound item baseline.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Restages saved waiting desires without minting another semantic transition ID, then commits only changed execution.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: No change returns COORDINATION_WAITING; arbitrary baseline or stale/disabled map refuses.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.

semantic_mapping.guard_assessment: Claim checks saved transition/intent/desire identity; record/conflict requires exact send attempt and current binding.
semantic_mapping.effect_assessment: Coordination follows matching effect to waiting_reconciliation, synchronized or waiting_manual.
semantic_mapping.retry_assessment: Unknown effects remain unknown and cannot be automatically reclaimed or retried under a new assumption.
semantic_mapping.dependency_limits: Local HTML/CAS/journal transitions only; remote observations are caller-supplied validated records. GitHub adapter authorization/network/readback execution is outside this source proof.
